title.narrative: Co-finance of National Dialogue on Nature-Based Solutions Ghanaian Coast November 3 and 4, 2025

description.narrative: The Water Resources Commission, Ghana Hydrological Authority which are agencies under the Ministry of Works, Housing and Water Resources together with the Ministry of Environment Science and Technology and the Environmental Protection Authority and other Ghanaian Institutions have been working together with the Dutch Water Authorities and several Dutch organisations such as Blue Deal, Partners of Water, Ecoshape, HKV to find sustainable solutions to the issues of coastal erosion, degradation, sea-level rise and flooding along the eastern coast of Ghana. These challenging issues are exacerbated by climate change. During workshops with local stakeholders, organised in 2024 and 2025, it was concluded that Nature-based Solutions that have been proven to be more sustainable should be blended with the hard solutions already implemented. There was therefore the call for a National Dialogue to enhance the understanding of all stakeholders and ensure that the views of all relevant groups are considered. In addition, a site for a pilot implementation of a Nature-based Solution has been selected and the next step is to carry out prefeasibility studies. The National Dialogue has been planned for the 3rd and 4th of November 2025 to be held at the Coconut Grove Hotel in Accra. The financial contribution to organize the National dialogue is earmarked to finance the activities of the first day of the 2-day workshop, where the following activities are planned:• Presentation of Climate Change Impacts by Expert;• Cultural Display Moderator;• Panel Discussion – Governance and Ownership Team;• Presentation – Nature-based Solutions options and enablers; and• Panel Discussion on Media Focus (telling the Story) PanelOther partners are co-financing other activities and costs of the National Dialogue.
